Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 7
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the task by anchoring the search to “the end year of the office holder’s term around 1963,” rather than identifying when the Governor of Vatican City (the city where Pacem in Terris’ author died) ended. The correct focus should have been on the office of the Governor of Vatican City (held by Camillo Serafini), which ended in 1952. This misframing set the effort on the wrong timeframe and led to repeated confirmation loops instead of converging on the correct year, 1952.
